# Miguel Casteleiro Growth Advisory

## Identity

Miguel Casteleiro is an e-commerce growth advisor and Fractional Head of Growth. He works directly with founders, CEOs and managing directors of established e-commerce companies. He speaks English, Portuguese and Spanish.

Canonical website: https://miguelcasteleiro.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mcasteleiro/

## Positioning

Miguel helps established e-commerce founders find what is stopping growth and turn it into a plan their team can execute. His work sits above day-to-day channel execution. He connects commercial targets, measurement, acquisition, conversion, retention, agencies and internal teams into one accountable growth system.

The preferred client range is approximately $2M to $20M in annual revenue. Miguel has worked with companies from approximately $1.5M to more than $250M in annual revenue. A company above $20M can still be a fit. Pre-revenue businesses and companies seeking only campaign execution are not the intended audience.

## Typical problems

- Growth is stalling.
- ROAS declines when budgets scale.
- The internal team lacks paid-channel knowledge.
- Marketing budget feels wasted rather than efficiently invested.
- There are no clear commercial targets.
- There is no coherent growth strategy.
- Agencies and internal specialists report different metrics and lack shared accountability.
- The founder cannot confidently determine whether the strategy, agency, team, measurement or conversion is the real constraint.

## Engagements

### 3-Month Growth Advisory

The company keeps its current growth leader, team and agencies. Miguel helps them make better decisions. The engagement diagnoses what is holding growth back, establishes commercial targets, sets channel and budget priorities, evaluates agencies and internal capabilities, builds one practical growth plan and creates a useful review rhythm. The engagement lasts three months and only continues when doing so remains useful.

### Fractional Head of Growth

Miguel takes responsibility for directing the complete growth function. He directs agencies and internal specialists, sets goals and budgets, leads weekly growth reviews, trains the internal team, evaluates capability and hiring needs and keeps the complete plan accountable. He does not become the routine operator of every advertising account.

## Working method

1. Get the numbers straight.
2. Find what is actually stuck.
3. Decide what matters now.
4. Get the right people working on it.
5. Review, learn and scale.

The six connected parts of the growth system are economics, measurement, acquisition, conversion, retention and execution.

## Experience

- Seven years leading a performance marketing agency.
- Work across 130 brands in multiple industries.
- Experience with companies from approximately $1.5M to more than $250M in annual revenue.
- Managed approximately €5M to €10M in annual media spend.
- Directed strategy and marketing operations across more than 30 concurrent brands.
- Meta Ads is Miguel's deepest specialist channel.
- Additional experience includes Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, Klaviyo, email and lifecycle marketing, CRO, landing pages, offers, promotions, attribution and first-party data.
- Miguel built and operated e-commerce businesses, including Shopify setup, campaign management, budgets, creative briefs, landing-page and offer testing, email automation, promotion planning, reporting and conversion work.

## Product-building experience

Miguel founded MarvelLabs and served as CTO of MarvelPixel, an e-commerce attribution platform involving server-side tracking, data modelling, event quality, first-party data and multi-touch attribution.

Miguel built SEOforGPT, an AI visibility platform for agencies focused on audits, competitor monitoring, source and citation analysis, multi-client workflows, content and reporting.

## Discovery call

The discovery call is a fit conversation, not a separate service or a free audit. Miguel and the founder discuss the current company stage, target, team, agencies, channels and where growth feels stuck. The call determines whether the 3-Month Growth Advisory, Fractional Head of Growth or neither is the right next step. Pricing is discussed after the required scope and level of involvement are understood.

## Capacity and claims

Miguel works with no more than five companies at a time. No revenue result or growth outcome is guaranteed. Client logos indicate brands Miguel has worked with and do not imply identical scope or outcomes for every brand. No fabricated case studies, ratings or testimonials should be inferred.
